name: Minimum determinant of a 10-dimensional lattice Gram matrix with minimum squared norm 4

parameters.minimum_squared_norm: at least 4 on nonzero integer vectors

source_review.definition: Ten-dimensional positive definite symmetric rational Gram matrix, every nonzero integer vector has squared norm at least4, minimize exact Gram determinant. Full lattice problem at fixed sphere radius1; nonlattice P10c scores are not lattice records.
source_review.primary_source: Nebe-Sloane Catalogue LAMBDA10 GRAM section, frozen10728-byte HTML SHA10a1fa86d38c92c30d4df0f95169d0fee64e3584bc7316e35b19d0c325229c1a. Independently downloaded and transcribed10x10 matrix, determinant768, minimum squared norm4,336 shortest vectors.
source_review.open_status: Dutour Sikirić/vanWoerden2508.20719v2 Introduction and Corollary1 close dimension9; explicitly exclude9. The proof does not close10, and reviewed contemporary lattice sources have no ten-dimensional optimality proof. General nonlattice packing uncertainty is not used as lattice evidence.
source_review.rational_model: Voronoi perfect-form principle: a densest form scaled to minimum4 is fixed by rational linear equations z^TGz=4 from spanning integer minimal vectors, hence may be rational. No arbitrary coefficient or basis bounds.
source_review.independent_arithmetic: Root first wrote a complete exact LDL ellipsoid enumeration prototype before task delivery, finding336 vectors norm<=4, all equal4, determinant768. Admission additionally applies a unimodular unitriangular integer basis change, uses separate Gaussian-elimination determinant and separate complete rational ellipsoid recursion. Formal checker searches original basis and only norm<4. No fixed coordinate box or partial enumeration accepted.
source_review.initial_and_search: Standalone4I determinant1048576; generic classical A10/D10/E8+A2 candidates and own seeded basis changes produce3072; external human/reference Lambda10=768. Init/search do not read external comparison data.
source_review.admission: Five strict budgeted runs, exact independent quantities, damaged indefinite matrix, whole-return declaration invariance, replay, cold export and error/nonfinite/timeout controls passed.
